claims.summary: Characteristic zero, lambda not in {0,1,-1}. If s_1,s_2,t_1,t_2 are Puiseux series in eps with v(s_2)=v(t_1)=theta>0, v(s_1),v(t_2)>theta, with kappa=lim (s_2/t_1)^2, the span of (1+s_i/S)^(-lambda)(1+t_j S)^(-lambda) converges on compacts of C^* to <S^-1, 1, S, S^2 + kappa S^-2>; the constant of the second-order terms is (lambda+1)(1-lambda)/12.
claims.assessment: Working proof by triangular bases of the two clusters and second-order cancellation; the two tied minimizing exponent sets are confirmed by exact Pluecker valuations at N=5.
claims.rationale: First case of the limit of a product of two multiscale clusters, needed for the middle components of caterpillar degenerations.

claims.summary: Characteristic zero, lambda=3/2, N=5 caterpillar a_j=c_j eps^(j-1), generic c: in S=eps^2 T the normalized pair space tends to <1> + phi<1,S> + <S^-3> + S^-l phi<1,S^-1> + S^-l<S^-1,1,S,S^2+kappa S^-2>, phi=(1+c_3 S)^-l, kappa=(c_2 c_4)^-2; for generic c exactly 12 simple Weierstrass points converge to this component, with no minimality condition.
